title: Exact Uniform Sampling of Contingency Tables with Arbitrary Margins
summary: OpenAI 数学仓库收录的研究手稿。展开查看英文摘要，或标记后让我进一步解释。

abstractEnglish: We give an exact uniform sampler for nonnegative integer contingency tables with arbitrary prescribed margins. It terminates almost surely and has expected bit complexity polynomial in both dimensions and the binary length of the margins. No positivity, balance, sparsity, or fixed-dimension assumption is required.
